name: blink-workflow-linter
description: Validate BlinkOps workflow YAML: structure, step ids, {{ }} expressions, flow control, action inputs, cron.

blink.pythonPath.description: Python 3 interpreter with PyYAML and jsonschema installed.

blink.filePatterns.description: Glob patterns of files always linted. Other YAML files are linted when they look like a Blink workflow (top-level 'workflow:' plus 'automation_type:' or 'name:').

blink.sniffWorkflows.description: Lint any YAML file that looks like a Blink workflow.

blink.lintOnType.description: Lint while typing (debounced). Otherwise on open and save.

blink.dataPath.description: Override folder holding schema/action-index/core JSON (e.g. a refreshed catalog).
